models.name: Life saved → illustrative QALYs
assumptions: The donor supplies the QALY yield; Market for Impact does not claim that one life saved equals a fixed number of QALYs.
The historical GiveWell cost-per-life figure is divided by that user-supplied yield.
No morbidity benefit, discounting, age weighting, or spillover is added.
limitations: GiveWell's headline cost-per-life figures are historical 2022–2024 directed-funding averages, not current marginal tranche estimates.
A QALY requires health-state utilities over time; this shortcut is a sensitivity check, not a source-published CEA output.

models.name: Economic benefit → Coefficient Giving dollars
models.modelVersion: Coefficient Giving current public formula, captured 2026-08-30
assumptions: One $CG is the welfare benefit of giving $1 to a person earning $50,000 per year.
The public formula uses logarithmic utility of income.
SROI is philanthropic value in $CG divided by philanthropic cost in USD.
limitations: The calculator requires a causal income effect, population, duration, and cost; none are inferred from grant amounts.
$CG is Coefficient Giving's welfare model and is not a QALY, WELLBY, or GiveWell benchmark unit.

models.name: GiveWell multiple → benchmark units
models.targetUnit: approximate GiveWell welfare units per USD
assumptions: GiveWell publishes approximately 0.003 benchmark units per US dollar at 1×.
The conversion applies only when the multiple uses the November 2025 consumption benchmark.
limitations: Older GiveDirectly-relative multiples and Founders Pledge's GiveDirectly model do not share this denominator.

models.name: Native outcome → WELLBY
models.modelVersion: Green Book wellbeing definition; MFI bridge v0.1
assumptions: One WELLBY is a one-point change in life satisfaction on a 0–10 scale for one person for one year.
A causal life-satisfaction effect, population, duration, and appropriate discounting are required.
limitations: The accepted evaluator rows do not publish the required life-satisfaction inputs.
Market for Impact does not translate animal outcomes, test-score gains, emissions claims, or lives saved into WELLBYs without a source-grounded bridge.

boundaries.label: Animal welfare
boundaries.nativeUnit: ACE program-specific reach and spending metrics
boundaries.reason: No accepted cross-species welfare weights or QALY/WELLBY bridge.

boundaries.label: Climate
boundaries.reason: No accepted organization-level emissions-per-dollar estimate in the current source set.

boundaries.label: Education
boundaries.nativeUnit: standard deviations per dollar or model-specific GiveDirectly multiples
boundaries.reason: Founders Pledge's 2023 GiveDirectly model does not share GiveWell's current benchmark denominator.
